leaves.name: eichlerOptEmbCount6
leaves.doc: gr-dict (bypass fold; count-only spec), printed form (pure algebra): Eichler's theorem on optimal embeddings for the maximal order O of the quaternion algebra (2,-3) of discriminant 6 (class number one): for an order R of conductor prime to 6 in an imaginary quadratic k, the O^x-classes of optimal embeddings R -> O are finite in number, h(R) * prod_{p|6} (1 - (k/p)). Replaces gonzalezRotgerProp56X6 by the bypass fold scratch/gr-dict/BypassFold.lean: the chain reads only the bound #CM(R) <= 2^b h(R) (GR56.r5fpCountLe_of_eichler with the textbook fields).
leaves.source: Eichler, J. reine angew. Math. 195 (1955); Vigneras, Arithmetique des algebres de quaternions, LNM 800 (1980), Ch. III Thm 5.11, Cor. 5.12; Voight, Quaternion Algebras (2021), Thm 30.7.3 (numbers UNVERIFIED); at the maximal order of (2,-3) (class number one), counted modulo O^x
